name: Apacer Technology Inc
blurb: Apacer Technology Inc is a Taiwan-based company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and sales of memory modules, solid-state drives (SSDs), and other digital storage solutions. The company serves various markets including industrial, automotive, and consumer electronics. Apacer is known for its focus on high-quality, reliable memory products and has established a strong presence in the global memory module industry.
